clue.text: It's a mistake to kiss, one may be fired

parts.note: a blunder is a bad mistake
buss is an old word for a kiss

explanation.surface: Someone warns that kissing is an error.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is about a kiss being a mistake; the definition at the end points to an old wide-mouthed gun.
explanation.definitionFit: An old short musket with a flared muzzle is a weapon that gets discharged.

clue.text: Flushing's high-water control

parts.note: flushing sounds like a flood or a blush, but it is a lavatory cistern's float valve that stops the water rising too high

explanation.surface: Flood defences for a place called Flushing.
explanation.definitionFit: A floating valve in a toilet cistern that shuts off the inflow when the level is high.

clue.text: He could be grounded and kept down

definitions.text: He could be grounded and kept down

parts.words: He could be grounded and kept down
parts.note: suggests a punished child or a pilot, but describes a dog that is pinned underneath, the loser in a fight

explanation.surface: A teenager is grounded and repressed.
explanation.definitionFit: The one expected to lose, pictured as a dog pinned underneath in a fight.

clue.text: Studies the East — it's thickly, populated

parts.note: dens are private studies or rooms for working
E is the abbreviation for East

explanation.surface: Someone researches the East and finds it crowded.
explanation.definitionFit: Crowded, with many people packed closely together.

clue.text: To carouse is to err drunkenly.

indicators.note: a drunk staggers about, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Partying hard means making drunken mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: To revel noisily, as at a boisterous party.

clue.text: Opens port in the sun perhaps

indicators.note: the port goes in the jumbled sun
perhaps hints that the letters of sun may be arranged otherwise

parts.note: Cork is a port in Ireland

explanation.surface: Someone opens a bottle of port while sitting in sunshine.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface wants 'port' as the wine being opened; it is the Irish harbour, set inside a reshuffle ('perhaps') of the star's name, and 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling the stopper from a bottle is opening it.

clue.text: A foreign girl who drops in after marriage

definitions.text: A foreign girl who drops in after marriage

parts.words: A foreign girl who drops in after marriage
parts.note: drops in sounds like visiting, but the Italian title for a young woman loses the letters IN when she marries and becomes signora

explanation.surface: A girl from abroad visits once the wedding is over.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian for an unmarried young woman, like Miss.

clue.text: A washer may need it and vice versa

definitions.text: A washer may need it and vice versa

parts.words: A washer may need it and vice versa
parts.note: a plumbing washer is fitted to a water fitting, and the fitting needs a new washer when it drips, so each needs the other

explanation.surface: Someone doing the laundry needs a supply, and the supply needs them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Washer' suggests a person washing up or a washing machine; here it is the small rubber ring inside a water fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A dripping faucet needs a new rubber ring, and that ring sits inside the faucet.

clue.text: Not being fully illuminated makes it wilt

indicators.note: the answer's letters make the following words when rearranged, so the clue signals a reshuffle

explanation.surface: A plant kept in half-darkness droops.
explanation.definitionFit: Lit only dimly, as at dusk, is not being fully lit.

clue.text: Searched for a resting place

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a bed is a place to rest

explanation.surface: Someone hunted for somewhere to lie down.
explanation.definitionFit: Investigated thoroughly, as a detective digs into a case.

clue.text: Left port carrying cargo

parts.note: Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: A ship leaves harbour loaded with goods.
explanation.definitionFit: A loaded ship is weighed down with its freight.

clue.text: Unidentified gin and tonic mixed together with love

indicators.note: drinks mixed together are combined and stirred, so the letters of the two drink words are rearranged

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A mysterious gin and tonic stirred up with affection.
explanation.walkthrough: The drink sits in the surface as a whole order; 'mixed together' works on its two words as letters, and 'love' is tennis's nil, joined at the very end.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone travelling under a false name keeps their identity hidden.

clue.text: A plane worker

parts.note: reads like someone who works on an aircraft, but the plane is the tool for smoothing wood

explanation.surface: Someone employed on an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworker uses a plane to shave timber smooth.

clue.text: Oil producer under pressure

parts.note: suggests a stressed oil company, but it is the fruit that yields oil when crushed in a press

explanation.surface: An oil company is being squeezed financially.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit of a Mediterranean tree is crushed in a press to yield cooking oil.

clue.text: Clothing strike?

definitions.meaning: an informal British word for clothes and gear

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for gear or garments, and also a verb for hitting someone hard.

clue.text: No beer left? That's the limit!

definitions.meaning: bitter is a British beer, and its end is when none is left
the very last extremity, as in fighting to the last

explanation.definitionFit: The last of a British ale, and the furthest extremity of a struggle.

clue.text: Port is left in it, in more than one way

definitions.text: Port is left in it, in more than one way

parts.words: Port is left in it, in more than one way
parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a vessel, and port wine may also be left on board

explanation.surface: A remark that the wine was left behind somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: On a vessel the left side is called port, and a cargo of port wine might also stay aboard.

clue.text: He's not alone in breaking the law

definitions.text: He's not alone in breaking the law

parts.words: He's not alone in breaking the law
parts.note: a criminal who is not alone belongs to a gang

explanation.surface: An accomplice shares in the crime.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of an organised criminal band.

clue.text: Game for a dance at the depot

parts.note: a base is a depot or headquarters
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: A party at a military depot.
explanation.definitionFit: An American bat-and-ball sport.

clue.text: Stop -this is a hold up!

definitions.meaning: to ... a flow is to stop it
a plant's stalk holds up the flower

explanation.definitionFit: To halt a flow, and a plant's stalk, which supports the bloom.

clue.text: Wine forced on some Irishmen

parts.note: made means compelled, as in made to do something
the IRA, Irish Republican Army, is a group of Irishmen

explanation.surface: Drink is pressed on a group from Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from a Portuguese Atlantic island.

clue.text: Sailor held by a devout Buddhist state

indicators.note: the sailor is held, so his letters go inside the Buddhist's

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist monk
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman is captured by a pious monk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held by' makes the sailor the inner piece; the opening A from the clue stays outside, in front of the monk.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of the USA, in the Deep South.

clue.text: Girl able to turn up a whole lot of dates

parts.note: Alma is a girl's name

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reads the word upward, so backwards

parts.note: can means be able

explanation.surface: A young woman manages to arrive for many romantic evenings.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests romantic dates; these are calendar dates. In a down entry 'to turn up' turns only the word for 'able', not the girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A yearly calendar listing days, events and tides.

clue.text: Scolded for raising details I left out

indicators.note: in a down clue raising lifts the word so it reads from bottom to top
the I is omitted from details

explanation.surface: Someone was told off for bringing up particulars with one omitted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left out' drops I from DETAILS, giving DETALS, and 'raising' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: Harshly criticised or rebuked.

clue.text: Requests direction and politely uses it

parts.note: pleas are requests or appeals
E, east, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: Asking for instructions, someone uses courteous words.
explanation.definitionFit: The courteous word added to a request is what a polite speaker says.

clue.text: I shall be among the French here

indicators.note: one piece being among another means it sits inside it

parts.note: le is French for the
I'll is the contraction of I shall

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to join the French.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be among' is the container signal. 'here' is a fair definition because the clue itself has just named the French setting: the place is a city in northern France.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in northern France, the place the clue points to.

clue.text: Orator expected to hold 'em in eager excitement

indicators.note: expected holds the next pieces, so they sit inside it

parts.note: due means expected
'em is a short form of them, here just its letters
agog means in eager excitement

explanation.surface: A speaker is expected to keep an audience in thrilled suspense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only a link: the two inner pieces sit side by side, and 'to hold' wraps the word for 'expected' around both of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabble-rousing public speaker who plays on crowd feeling.

clue.text: A shade envious?

explanation.definitionFit: A colour like grass, and jealous, since envy is called the green-eyed monster.

clue.text: His playing has serious intent.

parts.note: playing means acting on stage, and serious drama is what this actor performs

explanation.surface: A musician's performance is earnest.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor who specialises in sombre dramatic roles plays them in earnest.

clue.text: Spare one in the crowd

definitions.meaning: a film walk-on who fills out a crowd scene

explanation.definitionFit: Something additional, and a film walk-on who fills out a crowd scene.

clue.text: Colour shows a number have the old fashioned style

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals
ye is an old-fashioned way of writing the

explanation.surface: A colour shows a number in antique style.
explanation.definitionFit: A colouring agent, as used to tint fabric.

clue.text: Call round to set up joint management

indicators.note: set up suggests rearranging, so the letters are arranged anew

explanation.surface: Asking someone to visit to arrange shared running of a business.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is an invitation to visit; 'set up' turns the three words into a shuffled pool of eleven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people steering together, like a car fitted with pedals for both instructor and learner.
